posts.instagram:
Anniversary coming up? Skip another card.

Forever Begins Here is a 500-piece puzzle of a newlywed couple under a flower-filled gazebo, her bouquet full of color and his hands gently holding hers. It's part of the PuzzleVybe Moments of Us collection, made to celebrate Black love.

A card gets read once. This gives you an evening together, piece by piece, and a finished picture you can frame. It comes in a sturdy box, so it's ready to give for weddings and anniversaries too.
